summary: Floor plan| "No results" info for quick filters
text: Added a 'no results' message for floor plan quick filters. Empty quick filter results are explained as for normal filters.

summary: Floorplan| Quick filters "Visited" - need add the drawer with names of visited stands ( same logic as for any other filter)
text: Added a drawer listing visited stands for the floor plan 'Visited' quick filter, pinning a stand on click. Visitors can see and jump to stands they visited.

summary: Floor plan|It possible open hidden hall from exhibitors card
text: Stopped exhibitor cards opening stands inside a hidden floor plan hall. Stands in hidden halls stay hidden from exhibitor cards.

summary: Check cypress tests for floorpan
text: Fixed floor plan Cypress tests failing to create a WebGL context. Floor plan end-to-end tests run.

summary: add scans
text: Restored missing bulk badge scans for an event from logged request data. The missing lead scans were added.

summary: Print badge position fix
text: Fixed the print badge position for participants with more than one role. Print badge displays correctly for multi-role users.

summary: Portal. Floorplan. HeaderMini issue on mobile resolution
text: Fixed the floor plan mini header on mobile: no horizontal scroll and a fitting sign-in button. The floor plan header fits small screens.

summary: Order of Exhibitor filters in Display filters should be mirrored on Floorplan page
text: Added a Floorplan tab to Display Filters so admins can order, rename, toggle and restrict floor plan filters. Floor plan filters are configured like list filters.

summary: Investigate and Test Batch Print Badges Functionality with Old Report Functionality
text: Investigated missing badges in batch print files since the new reports, using a branch with the old report code. The cause of missing batch badges was investigated.

summary: Lessen the amount of code that we have on the front side in batch print file
text: Removed unused code and a library from the batch print badge file without changing its output. Badge printing is lighter and looks the same.

summary: Refactor: App Query stands optimization
text: Optimised the app API to fetch stands, media and images for all exhibitors in single queries instead of one per exhibitor. App exhibitor data loads with a few batched queries.

summary: Change floor plan mini header on the standart one from the websitebuilder
text: Replaced the floor plan's custom mini header with the standard website builder header on all devices. The floor plan page uses the site's standard header.

summary: Show placeholder on the badges
text: Showed a placeholder photo on every badge where the user has no profile picture. All badges without a photo show the same placeholder.

summary: Floorplan integrations refactor
text: Refactored ExpoFP and InVisual floor plan code into one place, removed MapsPeople, fixed types and added functional tests. Floor plan integrations are organised and tested.

summary: [admin panel] Add limitation to Zone filter in Check-in List
text: Limited the zone filter options in check-in lists and analytics. Check-in filters stay responsive.

summary: Badges | Redesign of templating and output
text: Reworked all badge templates so badges look the same everywhere they're printed or previewed. Badges print consistently from admin, builder preview and profiles.

summary: Fix "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'floorplan')"
text: Fixed a floor plan page error reading undefined data. The floor plan page loads.

summary: Bi-directional Sync Between Favorites and Floorplan Bookmarks
text: Synced favourite exhibitors and bookmarked stands on the ExpoFP floor plan in both directions. Favouriting an exhibitor bookmarks its stand and vice versa.

summary: Add a new simplified QR Code type to the admin panel: "Simplified Participant QR"
text: Added a Simplified Participant QR type that encodes only the attendee ID. Admins can issue lighter QR codes.

summary: Full Offline Support - ExpoFP
text: Added full offline support for ExpoFP floor plans in the app using ExpoFP's offline archives. Attendees can use floor plans without a connection.

summary: OCR Badge Scanning
text: Added OCR badge scanning in the app: reading name, company and job title from a badge format, matching locally then on the server, with an OCR-only event setting. Exhibitors capture leads by scanning printed badge text.

summary: Full refactor of filters
text: Refactored the frontend filters so queries live in the components that use them, not in the filters component. Filter queries run directly in their components, removing duplication and conflicts.

summary: Total design re-check
text: Re-checked the design of profiles and profile editing, meetings, groups and RFP pages. Profile, meeting, group and RFP screens were reviewed against the design.

summary: Rewrite components to TypeScript
text: Rewrote platform frontend components in TypeScript as they were updated. Updated components are typed in TypeScript.

summary: Write unit tests to all new components
text: Added unit tests for all new frontend components, with the floor plan as a priority. New components, including the floor plan, are covered by unit tests.

summary: Upgrade Material to Mui5
text: Moved the frontend from the old Material UI library to MUI 5. The frontend uses MUI 5 instead of two parallel UI libraries.

summary: Check query type and do not change type when equal
text: Added a check that only reloads page data when query parameters have actually changed. Pages skip reloading when their query parameters are unchanged.

summary: Rename in exhibitors table deprecated fields
text: Marked old hall, stand, image and video fields in the exhibitors table as deprecated and removed their code usages. Exhibitors no longer use the deprecated fields; code reads stands and exhibitor events instead.

summary: Delete sub_id field from table exhibitor_categories and ExhibitorCategories model
text: Removed the unused sub_id field from exhibitor categories and every place in the code that referenced it. Exhibitor categories no longer carry the sub_id field.

summary: Сache improvements (delete, multiple get)
text: Sent cache delete requests to the master host and investigated combining model and multi-key caching. Cache deletions go to the master host.

summary: Add PDF-files validation and delete invalid PDF-files
text: Added validation that uploaded marketing content PDFs are not broken, and bulk-removed broken PDFs across the platform. Invalid PDFs are rejected on upload and existing broken files were cleaned up.

summary: Refactoring buildPermissionRelationsForbiddenQueries method
text: Replaced the model method that built forbidden permission-relation queries with the PermissionRelationsService. Permission relation checks go through a single service.

summary: Refactoring of AbstractIndexQueryBuilder
text: Refactored the search index query builder towards a fluent interface for equals, contains, starts/ends-with and fuzzy matching. Index queries are built through a composable builder.

summary: Code improvement
text: Rewrote the meeting setup component to use a reducer. Meeting setup state is managed with useReducer.

summary: Create root enums for not-root enums
text: Created root-level enums for enums that lived outside the shared Enums folder. Enums are centralised, ready to be split into domain folders later.

summary: OTO button works incorrectly in admin panel
text: Fixed one-time password handling in the admin panel: paste support, clearer wording, code display with copy, OTP buttons on exhibitor and participant pages, a Resend button. Admins can paste, copy and resend one-time passwords, with OTP buttons next to Customer service on profile pages.

summary: redis maintenance config changes
text: Reduced the production Redis cluster from xlarge to large nodes. Production Redis runs on smaller nodes.

summary: OTP Android: allow entering password code by copypasting
text: Allowed pasting the one-time password into the Android app's OTP field. Android users can paste the full OTP code.

summary: Hide Password reset window when OTP is turned on
text: Hid the password reset popup on first login when one-time password login is on. OTP events no longer prompt users to change a password.

summary: Need to change the type for the field custom_fields if data is missing
text: Made the exhibitor member info endpoints always return custom_fields as an object, even when empty. custom_fields has a consistent type in the member info API.

summary: Optimization of sync with elastic after event clone
text: Delayed search index syncing after an event clone until the clone has finished. Cloned events sync to search only once the clone is complete.

summary: Define event is in session in all possiable entripoints to hand sync data on elasticsearch
text: Detected at every entry point whether an event is in session, to handle search data syncing. Search syncing knows the event context wherever it starts.

summary: Improvement of the information pop-up
text: Changed the required-fields popup on profile editing to say missing fields may be on another registration tab. The popup points users to other registration tabs.

summary: Consider using update_field for dictionaries
text: Evaluated incremental updates for ClickHouse dictionaries sourced from PostgreSQL, starting with the most expensive ones. Expensive dictionaries can refresh incrementally.

summary: Return all error messages in /api/v1/exhibitorCategories/saveSettings
text: Returned all validation errors from the exhibitor category settings API and updated its documentation. The API reports every error in one response.

summary: Refactor frontend api v1 ProfileController::getEventsForExport method
text: Refactored profile schedule export to read directly from the schedule service. Schedule export code is simpler and more efficient.

summary: Add Translation Cache Clearing Functionality to clearInstanceCached Methods
text: Added translation cache clearing to the instance cache clearing methods. Clearing an object's cache also clears its translations.

summary: rewrite ValidateTeamMemberModal to reactHookForm
text: Rewrote the team member validation modal from Formik to React Hook Form. The modal uses React Hook Form.

summary: /admin/appbuilder/content/undefined | /var/www/expo_backend/public/admin.php
text: Handled invalid input on the app builder content page instead of throwing a database error. Bad IDs on the app builder content page no longer cause an exception.

summary: /api/v1/exhibitors/content | universal/models/Media.php
text: Handled unreadable image formats when exhibitors upload content. Exhibitor content uploads cope with undecodable images.

summary: /api/v1/profile/profileSave | frontend/app/models/ExpoBackendObject.php
text: Resolved a database deadlock when saving profiles. Profile saves no longer deadlock on account attributes.

summary: /api/v1/search/sessions | frontend/app/models/TCachingTrait.php
text: Fixed an ambiguous column error in session search filtered by category. Session search by category runs without SQL errors.

summary: /api/v1/upload/file | /var/www/universal/models/Media.php
text: Handled file upload failures when thumbnails can't be generated. File uploads cope with thumbnail generation failures.

summary: /badge | universal/ValueObject/AbstractInt.php
text: Fixed badge requests that passed a zero ID where a positive value is required. The badge endpoint handles missing IDs.

summary: /exhibitors/product/* | frontend/public/index.php
text: Fixed the product page route that was called with a missing argument. Product pages open without errors.

summary: /index/referal/* | frontend/public/index.php
text: Fixed referral links that failed when the referral record wasn't found. Invalid referral links no longer crash the page.

summary: /index/resetPassword | frontend/public/index.php
text: Fixed password reset failing when the account couldn't be loaded. Password reset handles missing accounts.

summary: /profile/booking | frontend/public/index.php
text: Fixed the bookings page failing when VAT country data was missing. The bookings page loads without VAT country data.

summary: /profile/show/* | frontend/public/index.php
text: Fixed profile pages failing when the viewer's account couldn't be loaded. Profile pages open without errors.

summary: Return 403 instead of 500 error In oauth controller requests
text: Returned 403 or 404 instead of 500 for unknown actions on the oauth and cron controllers. Unknown actions get an access denied or not found response.

summary: Add event_id to DI for generateProfileImage
text: Passed the event ID into profile image generation so search syncing works. Generated profile images sync to search.

summary: Add event_id to DI for the top menu in admin panel
text: Passed the event ID for admin database and tag actions so their changes sync to search. Admin database changes reach search.

summary: Change extends in model SampleEvents
text: Changed the SampleEvents model to extend the Expo universal object base. SampleEvents uses the correct base model.

summary: Remove dependencies on 'category_id' attribute in account_attr table
text: Removed dependencies on the category_id account attribute across the code and stopped creating it. Accounts no longer carry a duplicate category attribute.

summary: Remove ExpoModerator and ExpoSpeaker models from the frontend and backend
text: Removed the unused moderator and speaker models, their dependencies and tables. Old speaker and moderator models are gone.

summary: Unify AdminLogsContext and LogInfoContext
text: Unified two admin log contexts to remove duplicated code. Admin log handling has one shared context.

summary: Transfere properties video_url embed and video_type from Exhibitor model to exhbitor_events.exhibitor_attributes
text: Moved exhibitor video URL, embed and video type fields into per-event exhibitor attributes, with a data migration. Exhibitor video settings are stored per event.

summary: Reffactorring using exhibitors.category_id attribute to exhibitor_events.category_id
text: Switched all code from the exhibitor-level category_id to the per-event exhibitor category and deprecated the old field. Exhibitor categories are read per event.

summary: Reffactorring hall and stand fields using from exhibitors table
text: Switched all hall and stand usage from exhibitor fields to the stands table and deprecated the old fields. Halls and stands come from the stands relation.

summary: Delete account unused information from account_attr and clean up code
text: Deleted unused account attributes such as age and birth date and removed their code references. Accounts no longer store the unused attributes.

summary: Optimize checkDeactivationUserAndRunDeletingEvents method in AccountEventsTrait
text: Stopped the deactivation check in account events from running repeatedly on each save. The check runs once per request.

summary: Items to do for admin panel
text: Completed a list of missed admin panel items from a review deck. The outstanding admin panel items were addressed.

summary: Send logs to Dynamo about tasks for sync  Elastic
text: Logged every search sync task to DynamoDB, including the request URL. Search sync tasks are traceable in the logs.

summary: Delete deprecated controllers from backend/app/controllers
text: Deleted deprecated backend controllers and the model methods only they used. The backend drops unused controllers.

summary: Create PermissionService
text: Created a permission service that checks meeting and message settings for exhibitors, participants, buyers, team members and products. Interaction permissions go through one service.

summary: Refactoring of checking the "Networking Opt-in" setting in /api/v1/getInteractions endpoint
text: Refactored the networking opt-in check in the interactions API to use the existing GDPR method. The interactions API uses one opt-in check.

summary: Improve relations between Module Management and Permission Matrix for meetings and messages
text: Moved meeting and message permissions from module management into the permission matrix, with a general Messages toggle. Organisers control meetings and messages in one place, with the matrix disabled when a module is off.

summary: Add fields with errors highlighting in exhibitors categories settings
text: Highlighted fields with errors in exhibitor category settings using the errors returned by the API. Admins see which category settings fields are missing.

summary: Remove Unused Requests and Methods in AppRouter.php
text: Removed commented-out routes from the backend router and the controller methods behind them. The router carries only live routes.

summary: Change sync of the whole event to bulk of Elasticsearch
text: Switched whole-event search syncing to the bulk API. Full event syncs to search run in bulk.

summary: Marketplace page requests optimization: re-organize request for Exhibitors in list-view.
text: Split the exhibitor search endpoint so categories and products load only in the marketplace list view. Marketplace exhibitor views load faster; list view requests full data.

summary: Refactoring: Move Old Frontend Redirects to ExpoFrontendController and Cleanup
text: Consolidated old-frontend redirects to the new frontend into one controller. Redirects to the new frontend live in one place.

summary: Refactoring: Clean-up commented code and unused dependencies in SpeakersController
text: Removed commented-out code, unused dependencies and templates from the old speakers controller. The speakers controller carries only live code.

summary: Refactoring: clean-up commented code and unused dependencies in ProfileController
text: Removed commented-out code, unused dependencies and templates from the old profile controller. The profile controller carries only live code.

summary: Refactoring: clean-up commented code and unused dependencies in SearchController
text: Removed commented-out code, unused dependencies and templates from the old search controller. The search controller carries only live code.

summary: Refactoring: clean-up commented code and unused dependencies in ProductsController
text: Removed commented-out code, unused dependencies and templates from the old products controller. The products controller carries only live code.

summary: Refactoring: clean-up commented code and unused dependencies in ExhibitorsController
text: Removed commented-out code, unused dependencies and templates from the old exhibitors controller. The exhibitors controller carries only live code.

summary: Refactoring: clean-up commented code and unused dependencies in DelegatesController
text: Removed commented-out code, unused dependencies and templates from the old delegates controller. The delegates controller carries only live code.

summary: Refactoring: clean-up commented code and unused dependencies in BrandsController
text: Removed commented-out code, unused dependencies and templates from the old brands controller. The brands controller carries only live code.

summary: Add loaders to listing pages
text: Added loaders to listing pages that had none, such as marketplace, sessions, delegates, events and exhibitor lists. Listing pages show a loader while data loads.

summary: Remove "Use Custom Edit Profile" setting
text: Removed the 'Use Custom Edit Profile' setting, keeping the custom edit profile always on. All events use the custom edit profile.

summary: Refactoring: optimization User Deactivation Task - deactivationEvents action
text: Stopped queuing the deactivation events task for newly created users. The cron queue skips new users.

summary: Refactoring: delete appointment_notifications and appointments table
text: Deleted the old appointments and appointment notification tables and all code using them. Legacy appointment tables are gone.

summary: Refactoring: Delete Webinar tables and models
text: Deleted the old webinar tables and models. Legacy webinar data structures are gone.

summary: Refactoring: Clean-up commented code and unused dependencies in NewsController and EventsController
text: Removed commented-out code, unused dependencies and templates from the old news and events controllers. The news and events controllers carry only live code.

summary: Admin logs. Add new admin panel actions in admin logs
text: Added new admin panel actions to the admin logs. Admin logs cover the new admin panel.

summary: Check and fix calendar with addition dates in the DateSelectCard
text: Fixed the date selector calendar to mark days with meetings or sessions on schedule pages. Schedule calendars mark days that have items.

summary: Refactoring: Delete unused BusinessMatching models and tables
text: Deleted unused business matching tables and models. Legacy business matching data structures are gone.

summary: Refactoring: Delete unused RoundTables models and tables
text: Deleted the unused legacy round table tables and models. Old round table structures are gone.

summary: Behaviour for the guest (unloginned user)
text: Applied permission relations, the Appointments module and My Favourites module settings to guests who aren't logged in. Guests only see meeting and favourite buttons the organiser has enabled.

summary: add local-ssl-proxy to the project
text: Added a local SSL proxy to the frontend project. Developers can run the frontend over HTTPS locally.

summary: Storybook build error (react-hook-form dependencies)
text: Changed the react-hook-form version to fix the Storybook build. Storybook builds again.

summary: "Resend activation link" for OTP
text: Added 'Resend activation link' to the one-time password flow for accounts that aren't activated. Unactivated users on OTP events can resend their activation email.

summary: Fix failing tests
text: Fixed failing frontend tests. The listed component tests pass.

summary: Changes to the events for Arab Health
text: Adjusted a community event's navigation and labels, renamed exhibitors to suppliers, and trimmed the burger menu, plus Android text colour. The community event shows the requested navigation and wording.

summary: Include additional indexes
text: Added search indexes for participant company and job title and news author. Search finds participants by company and job title and news by author.

summary: [ADMIN_UI] Add global API control for errors
text: Added global API error handling in the admin UI. The admin UI handles API errors in one place.

summary: CI/CD tasks
text: Configured CI/CD pipelines for the Discord bot and fixed project scripts. The bot builds and deploys through a pipeline.

summary: Relocate api-mobileapp.expoplatform.com TO https://api-mobileappmobileappmobileapp.expoplatform.net
text: Relocated the mobile app API host to a new domain. The mobile API runs on the new host.

summary: Fix for .some issue from error log
text: Fixed a frontend error on the profile edit page from an unsupported array call. Profile editing no longer throws that error.

summary: Error while updating additional object
text: Fixed a search index script error when updating additional objects. Additional objects update in search without errors.

summary: Transfer the functionality of /api/v1/index/getFilters to the FiltersService service
text: Moved the filters endpoint's logic into a filters service reused by notifications. Filter data comes from one service.

summary: Refactoring: combine models rfp and rfp requests to one universal models
text: Combined the RFP and RFP request models into universal models. RFP data uses shared models.

summary: Refactoring: combine models sample_events and schedule_times to one universal models
text: Combined sample events and schedule times into universal models and deleted an unused scheduler model. Schedule time data uses shared models.

summary: Refactoring: Delete model RegisterCategories and table
text: Deleted the unused RegisterCategories model and table. The legacy register categories structure is gone.

summary: [old admin panel] check item list in the menu
text: Fixed a menu item disappearing when the module manager is opened in the old admin panel. The module manager menu item stays visible.

summary: Change createPortal to Popper in the CustomTimePicker
text: Switched the custom time picker dropdown from a portal to a popper. The time picker dropdown positions next to its field.

summary: Old and new frontend, buttons with 'SignIn' role working wrong
text: Fixed header buttons with the Sign In role on both frontends so they act as login and hide for logged-in users. Sign In buttons behave correctly.

summary: Deploy the fix of the symbols for custom filters
text: Deployed the fix for special characters in custom filter values. Custom filters accept values like "Cote d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast)".

summary: duplicates at account info attribute
text: Removed the causes of duplicate account attribute rows and cleaned existing duplicates. Each account attribute is stored once per event.
